issues.summary: Customs manifest for MBL PSSU260777 (container PSSU2430001) shows 18 pallets versus 20 pallets on the B/L, blocking the import declaration for HBL MFCIM260021 until a post-arrival manifest correction was accepted on 2026-05-19.

decisions.summary: Minseo Park decided Meridian files the post-arrival manifest correction at its own cost of USD 90 and obtains written confirmation of the correction from Pacific Star.
Jiwoo Han handed over the task of filing Pacific Star's written manifest-correction confirmation to Hoon Jang as she leaves on 30 June.

tasks.summary: File Pacific Star's written manifest-correction confirmation for HBL MFCIM260021 / MBL PSSU260777 in the S-021 document register once received (contact Ryan Tanaka).

deadlines.what: Due date for filing Pacific Star's written manifest-correction confirmation in the S-021 document register.
